component.name: Big Video Converter
component.summary: Convert, trim and optimize video files

description.p: Big Video Converter is a GTK4 and libadwaita interface for FFmpeg. It converts one or many videos, provides hardware-accelerated encoding when available, and keeps common tasks understandable without hiding the resulting format and quality choices.

ul.li: Convert queues of videos to MP4, MKV, MOV or WebM
Trim segments and adjust crop, rotation, color and audio
Fit videos under a target size, or split them into parts that fit
Stabilize shaky footage, sharpen the picture and reduce noise
Apply color looks (.cube LUTs) or shaders and change the frame rate
Give any video its own settings while the rest of the queue keeps the general ones
Use NVIDIA, Intel or AMD acceleration with software fallback
Copy or re-encode audio and embed or extract subtitles
Apply reusable presets for common publishing and editing workflows
